faqs.question: Why are there 0 vacancies in Bihar, Jharkhand, Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Uttarakhand, etc. in SBI Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: Because the 1,538 vacancies in this particular notification are backlog vacancies, not the new regular vacancies for the 2026–27 recruitment cycle. A backlog vacancy generally represents a reserved-category vacancy from an earlier recruitment that remained unfilled. Therefore, the distribution is completely different from what you would expect from a normal SBI Clerk notification. Zero in Delhi/Bihar/Haryana etc. does NOT mean SBI will have zero regular Clerk vacancies there this year.

faqs.question: Will SBI Clerk 2026 vacancies be updated or increased later?
faqs.answer: Possibly, but don't assume they will be. The current notification is specifically for the backlog drive. The much more important development for most aspirants will be the separate regular SBI Clerk notification, which should contain fresh state-wise vacancies for the new recruitment cycle. If your state has zero seats in the present notification, wait for the regular notification rather than concluding that SBI Clerk has no vacancy in your state.

faqs.question: Why is there no vacancy in Delhi, Haryana, and NCR for SBI Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: This is a consequence of the backlog-vacancy nature of the current recruitment. It does not mean SBI has stopped recruiting Junior Associates in Delhi/NCR or Haryana. Also remember that SBI recruitment is organized according to State/UT/circle-wise vacancies, rather than simply according to where candidates live.

faqs.question: What should candidates from zero-vacancy states do for SBI Clerk 2026?
faqs.answer: Wait for the regular notification. If you're from Delhi, Haryana, Bihar, Jharkhand, Punjab, Uttarakhand, etc., choosing another state merely because it has backlog vacancies is not recommended unless you genuinely satisfy that state's local-language requirement and are eligible for the applicable reserved category. The regular notification is likely to be far more relevant.

faqs.question: Can I apply for SBI Clerk 2026 from another state?
faqs.answer: Yes, subject to the notification's conditions — but the important issue is the local language. SBI's Junior Associate recruitment is state/UT based. Candidates apply for vacancies of one State/UT only and must qualify the specified local-language test (LPT) where applicable. For example, living in Delhi does not prevent you from applying for Maharashtra, but if you select Maharashtra, you must be prepared for Marathi language requirements.

faqs.question: How strict is the Language Proficiency Test (LPT) in SBI Clerk recruitment?
faqs.answer: It is a mandatory qualifying requirement. The LPT checks whether you know the specified local language of the selected state (e.g., Marathi for Maharashtra, Gujarati for Gujarat, Tamil for Tamil Nadu, Odia for Odisha, Kannada for Karnataka, Malayalam for Kerala, Punjabi for Punjab, Bengali for West Bengal, Hindi/Urdu for UP). Candidates who cannot produce acceptable proof of having studied the specified local language in 10th or 12th standard must qualify the LPT. Failing the required LPT will result in disqualification.

faqs.question: Will applying outside your home state automatically cause LPT problems?
faqs.answer: No. Your home state is not the deciding factor. The important question is whether you can prove/meet the language requirement of the state applied for. A candidate from Delhi could apply for Maharashtra, but if they cannot establish Marathi proficiency through standard qualification routes, they may have to take the LPT. Do not choose a state simply because it has a lower cutoff.

faqs.question: If I apply for SBI Clerk from another state, where will my exam centre be?
faqs.answer: You can generally appear for the Preliminary and Mains examination at a notified examination centre of your choice/availability, subject to SBI's arrangements. However, your recruitment is against the state applied for. SBI's rules state that the local-language test (LPT) is conducted at a centre decided by SBI in the state applied for, at the candidate's own expense. (Exam centre ≠ state of recruitment).

faqs.question: How should candidates choose a state when applying for SBI Clerk?
faqs.answer: Choose the state where you genuinely satisfy the local-language requirement first; then compare vacancies and expected competition. The recommended sequence is: Language eligibility → vacancy → expected competition → posting preference. Remember that candidates are considered against the State/UT applied for and are posted in that state if selected.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Regular and Backlog vacancies in SBI recruitment?
faqs.answer: A Regular vacancy is a newly identified vacancy for the current recruitment cycle. A Backlog vacancy is a reserved vacancy from an earlier recruitment that remained unfilled and is carried forward to be filled through a special drive. The current 1,538-post notification is specifically a backlog recruitment, which explains the unusual state-wise vacancy distribution.

faqs.question: Can eligible candidates apply for both Regular and Backlog SBI Clerk recruitments?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you are eligible for both and SBI permits applications for both drives. They are separate recruitment drives. For example, an eligible SC/ST/OBC candidate could potentially participate in both the backlog recruitment and the upcoming regular recruitment, provided they satisfy the eligibility conditions of both.

faqs.question: Will the exams for SBI Clerk Regular and Backlog recruitments be separate?
faqs.answer: Do not assume they will be combined. The current notification is a separate Special Recruitment Drive, so candidates should treat it as a separate recruitment unless SBI subsequently announces otherwise. Expect separate application and exam processes.

faqs.question: Can General (Unreserved) candidates apply for these SBI Clerk backlog vacancies?
faqs.answer: No. The 1,538 backlog vacancies are reserved exclusively for SC, ST, and OBC candidates carried forward from previous recruitment drives. Unreserved / General category candidates cannot claim an SC/ST/OBC backlog seat.

faqs.question: What is the age limit and cutoff date for SBI Clerk Special Drive 2026?
faqs.answer: For the backlog notification, the basic age requirement is 20 to 28 years as of the cut-off date specified in the official notification, plus applicable relaxations for reserved categories (5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, up to 10–15 years for PwBD). Ensure you check your exact Date of Birth against the specific cut-off date stated in the notification.

faqs.question: Why are some states showing SC/ST vacancies but zero OBC vacancies?
faqs.answer: Because backlog vacancies are category-specific. If SBI had an SC/ST backlog in a particular state but no OBC backlog, it cannot convert or reassign those seats. A table showing SC: 0 | ST: 12 | OBC: 0 simply reflects historical unfilled reserved positions for that state, not a policy of ignoring OBC candidates.

faqs.question: Is the SBI Clerk 2026 question paper available in English?
faqs.answer: Yes. The examination paper is provided in English along with Hindi and the relevant regional language(s) depending on the state (e.g., English/Hindi/Marathi in Maharashtra, English/Hindi/Gujarati in Gujarat, English/Hindi/Odia in Odisha, English/Hindi/Bengali in WB, English/Hindi/Urdu in UP/Bihar). The question paper medium is separate from the LPT requirement.

faqs.question: Did SBI Apprentice recruitment reduce regular Clerk vacancies?
faqs.answer: No. There is no basis in the official notification to conclude that Apprentice recruitment reduced Clerk vacancies. SBI Apprentice and SBI Junior Associate are different recruitment streams. The 1,538-post announcement is a backlog drive, and the upcoming regular Junior Associate recruitment will provide the actual fresh vacancy numbers.

faqs.question: Why are videos claiming 9,000 to 11,000+ vacancies when this notification says 1,538?
faqs.answer: Because numbers like 9,000 or 11,000+ circulating online represent projected estimates for the upcoming Regular recruitment cycle, whereas 1,538 is the officially notified count for the Special Backlog Drive. Do not add backlog figures to unofficial YouTube estimates; wait for SBI's official regular notification.

faqs.question: Where can candidates download the official SBI Clerk notification PDF?
faqs.answer: The official notification should always be downloaded directly from SBI's official careers portal at sbi.bank.in/web/careers or bank.sbi/careers. Always verify the advertisement on SBI's official site rather than relying on unverified Telegram or social media files.

faqs.question: Should students run a Twitter/X campaign regarding uneven SBI Clerk vacancies?
faqs.answer: Campaigns will not force SBI to convert reserved backlog seats into UR seats, as backlog vacancies are legally reserved carried-forward positions. If raising concerns, the appropriate request to SBI would be to clarify state-wise vacancy requirements and release the regular SBI Clerk notification with fresh vacancies at the earliest.

overview: Assam Public Service Commission (APSC), Jawaharnagar, Khanapara, Guwahati, has issued official Advertisement No. 11/2026 for direct recruitment to 137 posts of Veterinary Officer / Block Veterinary Officer (VO/BVO) under the Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department, Government of Assam.

Candidates holding a Degree in Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Science (B.V.Sc & A.H.) from a recognized university and holding permanent residency proof (PRC or Employment Exchange card) of Assam are eligible to apply.

The posts carry Pay Band 4 scale of Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 1,10,000/- with Grade Pay of Rs. 12,700/- per month. Interested eligible candidates can register and apply online at https://apscrecruitment.in from 07 August 2026 to 06 September 2026.

overview: Mineral Exploration and Consultancy Limited (MECL), a Mini-Ratna-I Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE) under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, has issued official Advertisement No. 02/Rectt./2026 for recruitment of Executive Trainees in Electrical and Mechanical engineering disciplines.

A total of 13 Executive Trainee (E-1 Grade) vacancies are being filled through Direct Recruitment based strictly on the UPSC Engineering Services Examination 2024 (UPSC ESE 2024) score out of 1200 marks. overview: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has released the Official Notification for Open Recruitment Rally for enrolment of unmarried Indian male and female candidates as Agniveervayu (Other Than Science Subjects) for Intake 01/2027.
The Open Recruitment Rally will be held from 31st August 2026 to 07th September 2026 at two designated rally venues in Nagaland (Chumoukedima) and Andaman & Nicobar Islands (Port Blair).

Target States & Union Territories: 1) Chumoukedima (Nagaland) venue covers all districts of Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, and Sikkim; 2) Sri Vijaya Puram (Port Blair) venue covers all districts of UT of Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

Rally Schedule at Nagaland (NAPTC Chumoukedima): Women Candidates: 01-02 Sept 2026 (Reporting 01 Sept); Men Candidates: 04-05 Sept 2026 (Reporting 04 Sept). Cut-off reporting time is 10:00 AM on reporting date.

Rally Schedule at Andaman & Nicobar (Netaji Stadium, Port Blair): Women Candidates: 01-02 Sept 2026 (Reporting 01 Sept); Men Candidates: 03-04 Sept 2026 (Reporting 03 Sept). Cut-off reporting time is 10:00 AM on reporting date.

Date of Birth Block: Candidates born between 01 January 2005 and 01 July 2009 (both dates inclusive) are eligible to appear in the Open Recruitment Rally. Upper age limit on date of enrolment is 22 years.

Educational Qualification: Passed 10+2 / Intermediate / Equivalent Examination in any stream from recognized Central/State Education Board with minimum 50% aggregate marks and 50% marks in English; OR Passed 2-year Vocational Course with 50% aggregate and 50% English; OR Passed 3-year Diploma Course in Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics/Auto/CSE/IT/Instrumentation) with 50% aggregate and 50% English.

Monthly Stipend & Agniveer Package: 1st Year: ₹30,000/- (In-Hand ₹21,000); 2nd Year: ₹33,000/- (In-Hand ₹23,100); 3rd Year: ₹36,500/- (In-Hand ₹25,550); 4th Year: ₹40,000/- (In-Hand ₹28,000). Total Agniveer Corpus Fund contribution after 4 years is ₹5.02 Lakhs.

Seva Nidhi Package on Exit: One-time Seva Nidhi Package of approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs (candidate's contribution + matching Govt contribution + interest) on completion of 4 years engagement. Up to 25% of each batch will be enrolled in regular cadre of Indian Air Force as Airman.

Selection Process: 1) Initial Certificate Verification -> 2) Physical Fitness Test (PFT-I & PFT-II) -> 3) Objective Written Test (45 mins: English 20 Qs + RAGA 30 Qs) -> 4) Adaptability Test-I -> 5) Adaptability Test-II -> 6) Medical Examination (at 11 ASC Jorhat / 8 ASC Sri Vijaya Puram in Sept 2026).

faqs.question: Is a separate computer certificate mandatory?
faqs.answer:
No, not necessarily.

The notification requires working knowledge of computer systems. A candidate can satisfy this through a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations/language, or by having Computer/Information Technology as a subject in high school/college. So if you studied IT/computers as a subject in school or college, a separate certificate generally isn't required.

Important: Don't assume that every private certificate automatically qualifies. The relevant qualification is what the notification specifies.

faqs.question: Can I quickly obtain a computer certificate?
faqs.answer:
Be careful here.

Don't buy a random DCA/ADCA/Tally/online certificate just because an institute says it will work for IBPS. The notification specifies the type of computer qualification/knowledge accepted.

If you already studied computer/IT in school, college, BCA, etc., that may already satisfy the requirement.

faqs.question: Can final-year students apply?
faqs.answer:
Generally, no if they have not completed graduation by the prescribed cutoff.

For CSA-XV, the candidate had to possess a valid marksheet/degree certificate showing that they were a graduate on the date of registration, with the qualification as of 21 August 2025.

So someone still in 7th/8th semester and awaiting the result could not simply apply on the assumption that the degree would be completed later.

faqs.question: What is the age limit?
faqs.answer:
For CSA-XV:

Minimum: 20 years
Maximum: 28 years
Age calculated as on 1 August 2025
Candidate had to be born between 2 August 1997 and 1 August 2005, inclusive.

Relaxations included, among others:

SC/ST: 5 years
OBC-NCL: 3 years
PwBD: 10 years

There are additional relaxations for specified categories.

Female candidates do not get a general age relaxation merely for being female.

faqs.question: If I apply from another state, does my category become General?
faqs.answer:
No, simply applying for another state's vacancy does not automatically convert your category to General.

However, reservation and certificate requirements are governed by the applicable rules, and candidates should ensure their certificate is valid for the relevant recruitment.

Also remember that CSA recruitment involves state/UT-wise vacancies and local-language proficiency.

faqs.question: Does CIBIL score affect eligibility?
faqs.answer:
This is one of the most misunderstood clauses.

There is no single IBPS-prescribed minimum CIBIL score such as 700 or 750 in the notification.

The notification says the candidate must maintain a healthy credit history, with the minimum credit score being according to the policy of the participating bank.

More importantly:

Credit history is NOT a pre-condition for applying.

If an adverse account has not been updated by joining time, the candidate may need to get it corrected or provide an NOC from the lender. The final decision rests with the allotted bank.

faqs.question: What about caste/EWS certificates?
faqs.answer:
Candidates should follow the exact certificate requirements in the notification and applicable Government rules.

Don't assume that an old certificate automatically works.

For OBC-NCL/EWS especially, candidates should ensure that the certificate is valid for the relevant period and format required for the recruitment.

faqs.question: Are there sectional cutoffs and sectional timings?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

For CSA-XV Prelims:

Section	Questions	Marks	Time
English	30	30	20 min
Numerical Ability	35	35	20 min
Reasoning	35	35	20 min
Total	100	100	60 min

The sections are separately timed.

Mains also has separate section timings:

General/Financial Awareness — 35 min
General English — 35 min
Reasoning — 35 min
Quantitative Aptitude — 30 min

Total: 120 minutes.

faqs.question: Is there an interview or typing test?
faqs.answer:
No interview. No typing test.

The major stages are:

Prelims → Mains → Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

The LLPT is different from a typing test; it checks proficiency in the relevant local language.

faqs.question: What score should I target?
faqs.answer:
There is no single safe score for all India.

The cutoff varies according to:

State/UT
Category
Number of vacancies
Candidate performance
Difficulty level

For preparation, don't target merely the previous cutoff. Aim substantially above the expected cutoff.

For example, if a state historically has a Prelims cutoff around 75, preparing for 80–85+ provides a better margin than targeting 75.

faqs.question: Can I choose an exam centre in another state?
faqs.answer:
Yes, your examination centre and the state/UT for which you're applying are not necessarily the same thing.

The examination centre is allotted according to the options/availability specified in the application and IBPS arrangements.

But you cannot confuse exam-centre choice with the state vacancy you are applying for.

Your selected state/UT determines the relevant vacancy/local-language requirements.

faqs.question: Which batch should I buy?
faqs.answer:
This isn't an IBPS eligibility requirement.

For a beginner with ~60 days, I would not automatically recommend buying an expensive batch.

You need:

Prelims concept preparation
Daily Quant/Reasoning practice
English
Previous-year questions
Full mocks
Mains GA/Financial Awareness preparation

If a free/low-cost structured course covers these adequately, a paid batch isn't mandatory.

faqs.question: What should I enter under graduation specialization?
faqs.answer:
Enter your actual graduation degree/subjects exactly as reflected in your educational records.

For example:

B.Com → Commerce/appropriate subject
B.Sc → actual science subject
B.A. → actual subjects

Don't randomly select a specialization just to get past the form.

If the portal's dropdown doesn't accurately represent your degree, use the option/instructions specified by IBPS rather than inventing a specialization.

faqs.question: What if the application form shows a red error?
faqs.answer:
First check:

Required field missing
Incorrect date format
Photograph/signature/document size
Invalid qualification selection
Incorrect state/centre selection
Browser/cache issue
Payment/session timeout

Try Chrome/Edge, incognito mode, clearing cache, and a stable internet connection.

If the problem is on the IBPS portal itself, use the official IBPS help/grievance mechanism rather than relying on coaching-centre advice.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

For CSA-XV objective tests, 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer. There is no penalty for an unanswered question.

So:

4 wrong answers = −1 mark

faqs.question: Did the Mains pattern change?
faqs.answer:
Yes. CSA-XV introduced a revised Mains structure compared with older IBPS Clerk patterns.

The CSA-XV Mains structure was:

Section	Questions	Marks	Time
General/Financial Awareness	40	50	35 min
General English	40	40	35 min
Reasoning Ability	40	60	35 min
Quantitative Aptitude	35	50	30 min
Total	155	200	120 min

faqs.question: Can I use a provisional degree certificate?
faqs.answer:
The critical requirement is that you must have proof that you had already graduated by the prescribed date.

The notification specifically refers to a valid marksheet/degree certificate establishing graduation.

So if your university hasn't issued the original degree yet, a valid provisional certificate/appropriate university documentation can be relevant, but candidates should follow the exact DV instructions issued for that recruitment.

faqs.question: What about a previous FIR/criminal case?
faqs.answer:
Don't hide or falsify information.

If the application specifically asks about criminal/legal matters, answer according to the actual facts and the wording of the declaration.

A past FIR does not automatically mean that every candidate is permanently disqualified, but concealment or a false declaration can create serious problems.

For an individual case involving acquittal, pending proceedings, conviction, etc., the exact facts matter.

faqs.question: What is the application fee?
faqs.answer:
For CSA-XV:

₹175: SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM
₹850: all others

Both figures included GST.

There is no general female-only fee exemption.

faqs.question: I'm scoring 50–55 in mocks. Should I apply?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if you're otherwise eligible.

A mock score of 50–55 doesn't mean you cannot clear IBPS Clerk.

Your score depends on:

Mock difficulty
State/category
Cutoff
Accuracy
Speed
Improvement over the next several weeks

If you're currently at 50–55, I'd focus on getting to 65–70+ consistently, then pushing higher rather than abandoning the attempt.

overview: Konkan Railway Corporation Limited (KRCL) has published Employment Notification No. CO/P-R/02/2026 dated 31.07.2026 for open market recruitment of Group 'C' and Erstwhile Group 'D' posts.
KRCL invites online applications from eligible candidates domiciled in Maharashtra, Goa, and Karnataka, registered employment exchange candidates along the KR route, land losers, and KRCL employees.

Total Vacancies: 201 Posts — Senior Section Engineer S&T (05), SSE Mechanical (06), Junior Engineer Civil (25), JE Mechanical (07), Section Controller (09), Station Master (15), Commercial Supervisor (07), Goods Train Manager (10), Assistant Loco Pilot / ALP (30), ESTM-III (15), Technician-III Mechanical (15), and Track Maintainer-IV (57).

Pay Scale & Pay Matrix: SSE: Level 7 (Basic Pay Rs. 44,900/-); JE, Station Master, Section Controller, Commercial Supervisor: Level 6 (Basic Pay Rs. 35,400/-); Goods Train Manager: Level 5 (Rs. 29,200/-); ALP, ESTM-III, Technician-III: Level 2 (Rs. 19,900/-); Track Maintainer-IV: Level 1 (Rs. 18,000/-). Plus DA, HRA, Transport Allowance.

Eligibility & Qualifications: 10th / SSLC + ITI / CCAA for Technicians/ALP/ESTM-III; 10th Pass for Track Maintainer; Graduation in any discipline for Station Master/Section Controller/Goods Train Manager/Commercial Supervisor; Diploma / Degree in relevant Engineering stream for JE/SSE.

Preference Order in Recruitment: 1st Preference: Land loser candidates along KR line; 2nd Preference: Employment Exchange registered candidates along KR route; 3rd Preference: Domiciles of Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka & KRCL employees.
Age Limit (as on 01/08/2026): Group C Posts: 18 to 36 Years; Track Maintainer (Group D): 18 to 45 Years. Age relaxation: +5 Yrs for SC/ST, +3 Yrs for OBC-NCL, +10 to 15 Yrs for PwBD.
Application Fee: Rs. 1,180/- (Rs. 1000 + 18% GST). Full Rs. 1,000 fee is REFUNDABLE upon appearing in CBT for SC, ST, ExSM, Female, Minorities, EBC, and PwBD candidates.

Selection Process: Computer Based Test (CBT) tentatively scheduled in September 2026 -> Computer Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) for SCOR/SM/ALP -> PET for Track Maintainer -> Document Verification & Medical Exam.
How to Apply: Online registration link will go live on https://www.konkanrailway.com in the last week of August 2026.

detailsList: 1st Preference: Land loser candidates whose land was acquired for Konkan Railway Line between Roha (MH) and Thokur (KA).

No, not necessarily.

The notification requires working knowledge of computer systems. A candidate can satisfy this through a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in computer operations/language, or by having Computer/Information Technology as a subject in high school/college. So if you studied IT/computers as a subject in school or college, a separate certificate generally isn't required.

Important: Don't assume that every private certificate automatically qualifies. The relevant qualification is what the notification specifies.

faqs.question: Can I quickly obtain a computer certificate?
faqs.answer:
Be careful here.

Don't buy a random DCA/ADCA/Tally/online certificate just because an institute says it will work for IBPS. The notification specifies the type of computer qualification/knowledge accepted.

If you already studied computer/IT in school, college, BCA, etc., that may already satisfy the requirement.

faqs.question: Can final-year students apply?
faqs.answer:
Generally, no if they have not completed graduation by the prescribed cutoff.

For CSA-XV, the candidate had to possess a valid marksheet/degree certificate showing that they were a graduate on the date of registration, with the qualification as of 21 August 2025.

So someone still in 7th/8th semester and awaiting the result could not simply apply on the assumption that the degree would be completed later.

faqs.question: What is the age limit?
faqs.answer:
For CSA-XV:

Minimum: 20 years
Maximum: 28 years
Age calculated as on 1 August 2025
Candidate had to be born between 2 August 1997 and 1 August 2005, inclusive.

Relaxations included, among others:

SC/ST: 5 years
OBC-NCL: 3 years
PwBD: 10 years

There are additional relaxations for specified categories.

Female candidates do not get a general age relaxation merely for being female.

faqs.question: If I apply from another state, does my category become General?
faqs.answer:
No, simply applying for another state's vacancy does not automatically convert your category to General.

However, reservation and certificate requirements are governed by the applicable rules, and candidates should ensure their certificate is valid for the relevant recruitment.

Also remember that CSA recruitment involves state/UT-wise vacancies and local-language proficiency.

faqs.question: Does CIBIL score affect eligibility?
faqs.answer:
This is one of the most misunderstood clauses.

There is no single IBPS-prescribed minimum CIBIL score such as 700 or 750 in the notification.

The notification says the candidate must maintain a healthy credit history, with the minimum credit score being according to the policy of the participating bank.

More importantly:

Credit history is NOT a pre-condition for applying.

If an adverse account has not been updated by joining time, the candidate may need to get it corrected or provide an NOC from the lender. The final decision rests with the allotted bank.

faqs.question: What about caste/EWS certificates?
faqs.answer:
Candidates should follow the exact certificate requirements in the notification and applicable Government rules.

Don't assume that an old certificate automatically works.

For OBC-NCL/EWS especially, candidates should ensure that the certificate is valid for the relevant period and format required for the recruitment.

faqs.question: Are there sectional cutoffs and sectional timings?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

For CSA-XV Prelims:

Section	Questions	Marks	Time
English	30	30	20 min
Numerical Ability	35	35	20 min
Reasoning	35	35	20 min
Total	100	100	60 min

The sections are separately timed.

Mains also has separate section timings:

General/Financial Awareness — 35 min
General English — 35 min
Reasoning — 35 min
Quantitative Aptitude — 30 min

Total: 120 minutes.

faqs.question: Is there an interview or typing test?
faqs.answer:
No interview. No typing test.

The major stages are:

Prelims → Mains → Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

The LLPT is different from a typing test; it checks proficiency in the relevant local language.

faqs.question: What score should I target?
faqs.answer:
There is no single safe score for all India.

The cutoff varies according to:

State/UT
Category
Number of vacancies
Candidate performance
Difficulty level

For preparation, don't target merely the previous cutoff. Aim substantially above the expected cutoff.

For example, if a state historically has a Prelims cutoff around 75, preparing for 80–85+ provides a better margin than targeting 75.

faqs.question: Can I choose an exam centre in another state?
faqs.answer:
Yes, your examination centre and the state/UT for which you're applying are not necessarily the same thing.

The examination centre is allotted according to the options/availability specified in the application and IBPS arrangements.

But you cannot confuse exam-centre choice with the state vacancy you are applying for.

Your selected state/UT determines the relevant vacancy/local-language requirements.

faqs.question: Which batch should I buy?
faqs.answer:
This isn't an IBPS eligibility requirement.

For a beginner with ~60 days, I would not automatically recommend buying an expensive batch.

You need:

Prelims concept preparation
Daily Quant/Reasoning practice
English
Previous-year questions
Full mocks
Mains GA/Financial Awareness preparation

If a free/low-cost structured course covers these adequately, a paid batch isn't mandatory.

faqs.question: What should I enter under graduation specialization?
faqs.answer:
Enter your actual graduation degree/subjects exactly as reflected in your educational records.

For example:

B.Com → Commerce/appropriate subject
B.Sc → actual science subject
B.A. → actual subjects

Don't randomly select a specialization just to get past the form.

If the portal's dropdown doesn't accurately represent your degree, use the option/instructions specified by IBPS rather than inventing a specialization.

faqs.question: What if the application form shows a red error?
faqs.answer:
First check:

Required field missing
Incorrect date format
Photograph/signature/document size
Invalid qualification selection
Incorrect state/centre selection
Browser/cache issue
Payment/session timeout

Try Chrome/Edge, incognito mode, clearing cache, and a stable internet connection.

If the problem is on the IBPS portal itself, use the official IBPS help/grievance mechanism rather than relying on coaching-centre advice.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking?
faqs.answer:
Yes.

For CSA-XV objective tests, 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer. There is no penalty for an unanswered question.

So:

4 wrong answers = −1 mark

faqs.question: Did the Mains pattern change?
faqs.answer:
Yes. CSA-XV introduced a revised Mains structure compared with older IBPS Clerk patterns.

The CSA-XV Mains structure was:

Section	Questions	Marks	Time
General/Financial Awareness	40	50	35 min
General English	40	40	35 min
Reasoning Ability	40	60	35 min
Quantitative Aptitude	35	50	30 min
Total	155	200	120 min

faqs.question: Can I use a provisional degree certificate?
faqs.answer:
The critical requirement is that you must have proof that you had already graduated by the prescribed date.

The notification specifically refers to a valid marksheet/degree certificate establishing graduation.

So if your university hasn't issued the original degree yet, a valid provisional certificate/appropriate university documentation can be relevant, but candidates should follow the exact DV instructions issued for that recruitment.

faqs.question: What about a previous FIR/criminal case?
faqs.answer:
Don't hide or falsify information.

If the application specifically asks about criminal/legal matters, answer according to the actual facts and the wording of the declaration.

A past FIR does not automatically mean that every candidate is permanently disqualified, but concealment or a false declaration can create serious problems.

For an individual case involving acquittal, pending proceedings, conviction, etc., the exact facts matter.

faqs.question: What is the application fee?
faqs.answer:
For CSA-XV:

₹175: SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/DESM
₹850: all others

Both figures included GST.

There is no general female-only fee exemption.

faqs.question: I'm scoring 50–55 in mocks. Should I apply?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if you're otherwise eligible.

A mock score of 50–55 doesn't mean you cannot clear IBPS Clerk.

Your score depends on:

Mock difficulty
State/category
Cutoff
Accuracy
Speed
Improvement over the next several weeks

If you're currently at 50–55, I'd focus on getting to 65–70+ consistently, then pushing higher rather than abandoning the attempt.

The recruitment is governed by the Punjab State Elementary Education (Physical Training Instructor) Service Rules, 2023 and Punjab State Elementary Education (Physical Training Instructor) Service (First Amendment) Rules, 2025.

Total Fresh Vacancies: 2000 Posts — General: 780, EWS: 200, SC (M&B): 200, SC (R&O): 200, BC: 200, Ex-Servicemen: 260, Sports Quota: 60, Physically Handicapped: 80, Freedom Fighter: 20. Out of total vacancies, 650 posts are horizontally reserved for women across all categories.

faqs.question: What are the Physical Eligibility Test (PET) norms for male and female candidates?
faqs.answer: Male PET: 30m flying start (5s), Standing broad jump (1.40m), 6x10m shuttle run (17.5s), Bend & reach (2cm), 1600m run (8 min). overview: Ordnance Factory Dehu Road (OFDR), Pune, Maharashtra — a key production unit of Munitions India Limited (MIL), Ministry of Defence, Government of India — has issued Full Advertisement No. 1914/96/AOCP(50)/Phase-II/HRM/2026 for engagement of tenure-based contractual personnel.

Offline applications are invited from eligible Ex-Apprentices of AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant) trade or its feeder trades for the post of Tenure-Based Danger Building Worker (DBW) in Skilled level.
Total Vacancies: 14 Posts. Category Breakdown: SC - 05 Posts, ST - 02 Posts, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) - 03 Posts, EWS - 04 Posts (including 05 horizontal vacancies reserved for Ex-Servicemen).
Not Identified for PwBD: The Danger Building Worker post involves handling explosive ammunition materials and is not identified for PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disabilities) candidates.

Pay Structure & Remuneration: Basic Pay of Rs. 19,900/- + Central DA + HRA (if factory quarters are unavailable) + EPF + Bonus + Risk Allowance. Daily remuneration is calculated @ 1/30th of basic pay + DA for an 8-hour shift.
Tenure Period: Engagement is initially for a period of ONE year, extendable up to a maximum period of FOUR years based on factory requirement and individual performance review.

Essential Qualification: Ex-Apprentices of AOCP trade or feeder trades (IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration & AC Mechanic) from Ordnance Factories OR Government/Private ITIs recognized by NCVT/NCTVT.

Selection Method: Merit list based on 80% weightage for NCTVT (NAC) exam marks + 20% weightage for Trade Test / Practical Test conducted by OFDR Pune, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination.
Application Fee: NIL — Absolutely no application fee for any category.

detailsList: Category Breakup: SC - 05, ST - 02, OBC - 03, EWS - 04, Ex-SM - 05 (Horizontal).

Tie Resolution Criteria: In case of equal marks, precedence is given to: (i) Higher marks in NCTVT (NAC) exam -> (ii) Ex-Trade Apprentice of Ordnance Factory Dehu Road, Pune -> (iii) Ex-Trade Apprentice of other Ordnance Factories -> (iv) Older Candidate by Date of Birth.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official website of Munitions India Limited at https://munitionsindia.in/career or Department of Defence Production portal at https://ddpdoo.gov.in.
Step 2: Download the official Notification No. 1914/96/AOCP(50)/Phase-II/HRM/2026 and print the prescribed Application Form (Pages 8-11).
Step 3: Fill out the application form completely in BLOCK LETTERS using a blue/black ballpoint pen.

Step 4: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the application form and firmly paste one extra photo. Enclose two additional self-attested photos with candidate's Name and DOB written on the back side.

Step 5: Enclose self-attested copies of required certificates: (a) Class 10th/SSC Certificate for DOB proof, (b) NCTVT/NCVT NAC Certificate & Marksheet in AOCP or feeder trade, (c) Caste / EWS Certificate in prescribed Central Government format, (d) OBC Creamy Layer Declaration (Appendix-I), (e) Ex-Servicemen Undertaking (Appendix-II) if applicable, (f) Bank account details (cancelled cheque/passbook copy) for SC/ST TA reimbursement.
Step 6: Place the application form and all self-attested enclosures in a envelope.
Step 7: Super-scribe on top of the envelope in bold letters: "APPLICATION FOR 'TENURE BASED DBW (AOCP Trade or Feeder Trade)' PERSONNEL ON CONTRACT BASIS".

Step 8: Send the filled application strictly via Post / Speed Post / Registered Post to: The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Dehu Road, Pune, Maharashtra - 412101 (Tel: 020-27167246 / 020-27167298).
Step 9: Ensure the application reaches OFDR Pune within 21 Days from the date of publication of advertisement in Employment News.

overview: CSIR - National Geophysical Research Institute (CSIR-NGRI), a premier national laboratory under Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), Uppal Road, Hyderabad - 500007, Telangana has released Notification No. PP - 07/2026 dated 27.07.2026.

CSIR-NGRI is conducting Walk-in-Interviews (with an option for Online Interview via prior Google Form submission) to fill 18 temporary Project Personnel positions across various sponsored and in-house geophysical research projects.

The vacant positions include Project Assistant-II (02 posts), Project Associate-I (11 posts), Project Associate-II (03 posts), Principal Project Associate (01 post), and Project Scientist-III (01 post).

Projects encompass major earth science domains including Seismic Monitoring of Sri Komaravelli Mallanna Sagar Reservoir (Telangana), Geophysical studies at UCIL Mine Tummalapalli (AP), Ground Gravity & Magnetic Surveys (Maharashtra), Heliborne Geophysical Surveys for Ajanta & Manmad-Indore Rail Tunnels, CO2 Storage Site Monitoring, MEQ Stations around Rajasthan & Gujarat Atomic Power Plants (RAPP/KAPP), Chronostratigraphic & Provenance Analysis for Oil India Limited, and Critical Minerals Mapping.

Candidates unable to attend physical Walk-in interviews in Hyderabad can register for Online Interviews by filling out the Google Form and uploading the prescribed application form with single PDF certificates on or before 03rd August 2026.

overview: The Indian Air Force (IAF) has released the official Information Brochure and Application Form guidelines for selection as "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" under the Agnipath scheme for Intake 01/2027.

This recruitment offers an opportunity for eligible unmarried Indian male candidates who have passed Matriculation (Class 10th) to serve in the Indian Air Force for a four-year engagement period in the Hospitality or Housekeeping streams.

Candidates enrolled under this entry will receive a customized monthly Agniveer package starting at ₹30,000/- per month in the 1st year, rising up to ₹40,000/- in the 4th year, along with Risk & Hardship allowances, dress, travel allowances, ration, clothing, accommodation, CSD canteen facilities, and medical care at service hospitals.

Upon completion of 4 years of service, candidates will receive a one-time tax-free "Seva Nidhi" package of approximately ₹10.04 Lakhs (comprising their monthly contribution along with matching contribution by the Government of India plus accrued interest) and an official Agniveer Skill Certificate.
Additionally, based on organizational requirements and performance during the 4-year tenure, up to 25% of each batch will be enrolled into the regular cadre of the IAF as NC(E)s.

Interested candidates must download the blank application form from the official portal https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in under the sub-tab "Application Forms" under "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant", fill it in CAPITAL LETTERS, and submit it along with required self-attested documents and a ₹10 stamped self-addressed envelope via Normal Post or Drop Box at any ONE designated IAF station location on or before 17th August 2026.

howToApply: Step 1: Download the blank application form and guidelines hosted on the web portal https://iafrecruitment.edcil.co.in under the sub-tab "Application Forms" under the "Agniveervayu Non-Combatant" tab.
Step 2: Print the application form on plain white A4 paper. Fill all details accurately in CAPITAL LETTERS ONLY using a blue/black ballpoint pen.
Step 3: Select only ONE stream in which you intend to apply (Hospitality OR Housekeeping). Writing multiple streams will lead to rejection.

Step 4: Paste one self-attested passport-size colour photograph on the top right corner of the application form and admit card. Take a photograph holding a black slate in front of your chest with your Name and Date of Photograph written in white chalk in CAPITAL letters.
Step 5: Fill in personal details (Name, Aadhaar No, Father's Name, Mother's Name, DOB, Nationality, Address with PIN code, Mobile No, Email ID, Educational details).

Step 6: Attach self-attested copies of required certificates: Class 10th Passing Certificate & Marksheet, Aadhaar Card, Character Certificate (signed by Gazetted Officer/Panchayat Officer/Principal, not older than 6 months), and Parent/Legal Guardian Consent Form (mandatory if below 18 years).
Step 7: Attach one self-addressed envelope with Ten Rupees (₹10) postage stamp affixed along with the application form.

Step 8: Submit the completed application envelope by Normal Post OR drop it directly in the designated Drop Box at any ONE of the 134 listed IAF Stations/Locations (e.g., Bengaluru, New Delhi, Gandhinagar, Pune, Thane, Bhuj, Jodhpur, Jamnagar, Vadodara, Jaisalmer, Mumbai, Chandigarh, Kanpur, Guwahati, etc.) on or before 17th August 2026.
Important Note: Submitting multiple applications across different stations or formats not as per prescribed portal template will result in total rejection of candidature.
documentsRequired: Class 10th / Matriculation Marksheet and Class 10th Passing Certificate (as proof of educational qualification and Date of Birth).
Aadhaar Card self-attested copy (Candidates from J&K, Assam, and Meghalaya are exempted if Aadhaar is unavailable).
Character Certificate signed by a Gazetted Officer / Panchayat Officer / School Principal / College Principal (issued within the last 6 months bearing official seal).

Passport size recent colour photograph (taken holding a black slate in front of chest with candidate name and date of photo written in white chalk in CAPITAL letters). Retain 2 extra copies for enrolment.
Consent Certificate signed by Parent/Legal Guardian (if candidate is below 18 years of age) or self-signed consent certificate (if 18+ years).

Discharge Certificate / Pension Payment Order (PPO) if father is a retired/serving/deceased Air Force person (Airman/NC(E)/Civilian) to claim priority preference.
Experience Certificate in Hospitality / Housekeeping trade (if any).
importantInstructions: Engagement Duration: Enrolment is under the Air Force Act 1950 for a fixed period of 4 years. Agniveervayu Non-Combatant forms a distinct rank in the IAF.

Marital Status Undertaking: Only unmarried male candidates are eligible. Enrolled candidates must sign an undertaking not to marry during the 4-year engagement period. Marrying during service will lead to immediate dismissal.

Regular Cadre Absorption: On completion of 4 years, up to 25% of each batch may be enrolled in the regular cadre of IAF as NC(E) based on organizational requirements and centralized objective criteria.
Four-Year Salary Breakdown:
• 1st Year: Customised Package ₹30,000/pm (In-hand 70%: ₹21,000/pm | Corpus Fund 30%: ₹9,000/pm | Govt Matching Contribution: ₹9,000/pm)
• 2nd Year: Customised Package ₹33,000/pm (In-hand 70%: ₹23,100/pm | Corpus Fund 30%: ₹9,900/pm | Govt Matching Contribution: ₹9,900/pm)
• 3rd Year: Customised Package ₹36,500/pm (In-hand 70%: ₹25,550/pm | Corpus Fund 30%: ₹10,950/pm | Govt Matching Contribution: ₹10,950/pm)
• 4th Year: Customised Package ₹40,000/pm (In-hand 70%: ₹28,000/pm | Corpus Fund 30%: ₹12,000/pm | Govt Matching Contribution: ₹12,000/pm)
• Seva Nidhi Package on Exit: Approx ₹10.04 Lakhs (Tax Free) + Accrued Interest.
Zero Tolerance Policy: IAF enforces a strict Zero Tolerance policy regarding alcoholism, narcotics, and psychotropic substances (NDPS Act 1985). Violators face immediate dismissal.

Permanent Debarment: Attempting unfair means, carrying electronic gadgets/mobile phones into exam halls, impersonation, or submitting forged admit cards/documents will lead to permanent debarment from IAF selection tests and prosecution.

overview: Solid State Physics Laboratory (SSPL), Delhi, a premier research laboratory under the Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO), Ministry of Defence, is engaged in pioneering research in advanced semiconductor materials and devices.

overview: Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Baloda Bazar (Chhattisgarh) has published advertisement No. 2057/II-12-17/2013 dated 23rd July 2026 for direct recruitment to 18 sanctioned vacant posts.

The advertised positions include Stenographer Grade-3 Hindi (1 UR post), Stenographer Grade-3 English (2 posts: 1 UR, 1 ST), and Assistant Grade-3 Cadre (Execution Clerk, Evidence Writer & Process Writer - 15 posts: 9 UR, 1 OBC, 2 SC, 3 ST). Total = 18 Posts.

Eligible Indian citizens with Graduation from a recognized University, Hindi/English Shorthand/Typing certificate, and 1-year Computer Diploma (DCA/PGDCA) can submit physical applications in the prescribed format.

Duly filled application forms enclosed in a sealed envelope superscribed with the post name must be dropped in the designated application box kept at the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Baloda Bazar by 14th August 2026 (5:30 PM). Applications sent via post, registry, courier, or email will NOT be accepted.

selectionProcess.description: A 50-mark objective test containing 25 questions on General Knowledge, Current Affairs, General Mathematics, and Mental Ability (30 Minutes duration). Candidates will be shortlisted for skill test in a 1:10 ratio based on merit.
Dictation of 500 words at 100 WPM for 5 minutes, to be typed on computer within 45 minutes (500 marks). Additional typing and computer knowledge test (5000 key depressions per hour).

Typing of a mixed passage of about 250 words (Hindi and English) in 10 minutes (250 marks). Additional typing and computer knowledge test (5000 key depressions per hour). Conducted on Ubuntu Linux LibreOffice (Hindi-Vedmata / Kruti Dev 010). 1/2 mark deducted per error.
Verification of original degree, shorthand, computer diploma, domicile, and caste certificates. Selected candidates will be appointed on probation for 3 years.

howToApply: Step 1: Download the official advertisement and Application Form Format from the Baloda Bazar Court website (https://districts.ecourts.gov.in/balodabazar).
Step 2: Print the Application Form and fill all columns in Hindi/English capital letters cleanly.
Step 3: Attach self-attested photocopies of Graduation degree, Shorthand certificate, 1-year Computer Diploma, Chhattisgarh domicile certificate, caste certificate, and ID proof.
Step 4: Affix passport size photograph and sign the declaration.
Step 5: Enclose the filled application form and attachments in a sealed envelope superscribing "Application for the Post of ______ (Category: ______)".

Step 6: Drop the sealed envelope in the designated drop box kept at the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Baloda Bazar (C.G.) by 14/08/2026 (05:30 PM). Note: Applications sent via post, courier, or email will NOT be accepted.

Hindi / English Shorthand Exam Pass Certificate (for Steno posts).
One-Year Computer Diploma Certificate (DCA / PGDCA / IT Diploma).
Chhattisgarh Domicile / Native Residence Certificate.
Caste Certificate issued by competent authority (if claiming reservation).
Proof of Date of Birth (High School 10th Certificate).
No Objection Certificate (NOC) if working in Govt/Semi-Govt organization.
importantInstructions: Applications sent by Post, Registered Post, Courier, or Email will NOT be accepted under any circumstances. Applications MUST be dropped in the court drop box.
The typing test will be conducted on Ubuntu Linux operating system using LibreOffice (Hindi-Vedmata / Kruti Dev 010 font). Half mark will be deducted for every error.
Selected candidates will undergo a 3-year probation period as per CG State Government service rules.
The benefit of reservation is applicable strictly to native residents of Chhattisgarh.

overview: In light of guideline letter nos. 748 and 749 dated 24.04.2026 issued by the Secretary, Social Welfare Department, Bihar, Patna, the Office of the Assistant Director, District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Jamui has released Advertisement No. 02/2026.

Applications are invited from eligible candidates who are permanent residents of Jamui district for empanelment on 15 temporary posts of Support Person under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012 and POCSO Rules, 2020.
Category-wise Breakup (Total 15 Requirement): Unreserved (UR: 5 - 3 Male, 2 Female), SC/ST (4 - 2 Male, 2 Female), Minority (3 - 2 Male, 1 Female), BC/EBC (3 - 2 Male, 1 Female).

Role & Honorarium: Empanelled Support Persons render assistance to child victims in POCSO Court / Child Welfare Committee / Police investigations and receive a remuneration of ₹9,000/- per case (inclusive of travel expenses).

Eligible candidates with Post-Graduation in MSW, Sociology, Psychology, or Child Development (or Graduation + Child Rights Diploma + 3 years experience) must send their physical applications by Speed Post or Registered Post to the Assistant Director, DCPU Jamui by 15th July 2026 (5:00 PM).

overview: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB), DGP Office Complex, Lakdi-Ka-Pul, Hyderabad, has issued recruitment notification Rc No. 189/Rect./Rect-2/2026 dated 29th July 2026 for direct recruitment to 7,112 executive and technical posts across Police, Fire Services, Prisons, and Special Protection Force Departments.

Vacancies Advertised: SCT Police Constable Civil (3,697 posts including 27 backlog), SCT Police Constable AR (1,052 posts including 32 backlog), SCT Police Constable SAR CPL Men (24 posts), SCT Constable in Special Protection Force (1,380 posts including 8 backlog), Fire Fighter in Telangana Fire & Disaster Response Dept (751 posts including 11 backlog), Warder Male in Prisons (196 posts including 2 backlog), and Warder Female in Prisons (12 posts).

Step 6: Upload soft copy of recent Passport Size Photograph + Specimen Signature combined as one image file in .jpg format (Size: 30 KB to 100 KB).

overview: The Telangana State Level Police Recruitment Board (TSLPRB), DGP Office Complex, Lakdi-Ka-Pul, Hyderabad, has issued three major recruitment notifications (Rc. Nos. 225, 279, and 234/Rect./2026) dated 29th July 2026 for direct recruitment to 325 executive and technical posts across Police, Fire Services, Prisons, and Special Protection Force Departments.

faqs.question: 1. Can candidates from other states (UP, Rajasthan, etc.) apply?
faqs.answer:
Yes. This recruitment is open to candidates from outside Haryana. However, other-state candidates:

• Pay the higher application fee slab (₹1,500, same as Haryana General/UR male candidates)
• Compete only in the Unreserved/General category — reservation benefits (DSC, OSC, BC-A, BC-B, EWS, ESM, PwBD) are available only to candidates who hold Haryana domicile

So a Rajasthan or UP candidate can apply, but won't get OBC/category relaxation even if they belong to that category in their home state.

faqs.question: 2. Is the exam CBT (Computer-Based) or OMR-based?
faqs.answer: The written test for all three posts is described as MCQ-based. The Clerk post additionally has a computer-based typing test (typed on computer, English, 30 NWPM minimum) that comes before the written test. The official notification doesn't explicitly use the words "CBT" or "OMR" for the written paper in available sources — if this matters for your prep (OMR bubble-sheet vs on-screen computer test), it's worth double-checking the exact mode in the detailed notification PDF or the university's exam-guidelines annexure, since this affects how you practice.

faqs.question: 3. What is the syllabus, and which books/batches are recommended?
faqs.answer:
Syllabus (from the official pattern):

• Staff Nurse & Ayurvedic Pharmacist (105 min, 90 marks, 90 Qs, no negative marking): Concerned subject/field – 50 marks; Reasoning & Mathematics – 10; Haryana GK & Current Affairs – 10; General English & Hindi – 10; Basic Computer Knowledge – 10.
• Clerk (90 min, 70 marks, 70 Qs, after clearing typing test, no negative marking): Reasoning & Mathematics – 20; Haryana GK & Current Affairs – 20; General English & Hindi – 20; Basic Computer Knowledge – 10.

Recommendation on coaching books or YouTube batches varies and changes fast; candidates are advised to check official study materials and course announcements.

faqs.question: 4. Is Haryana Registration or Haryana CET required?
faqs.answer:
This is important and commonly confused with HSSC recruitments:

• This is a university-level, direct recruitment by SKAU, not conducted through HSSC's CET (Common Eligibility Test) system. Based on the official pattern, SKAU is holding its own written test for each post — there's no mention of a CET Group-C/Group-D screening prerequisite in the official advertisement summary.
• Staff Nurse applicants do need active "A-grade Nurse" registration with the Haryana Nurses Registration Council (or an equivalent body) — that's a professional registration requirement specific to the nursing post, not the same thing as Haryana CET.

faqs.question: 5. Can I apply with a provisional degree, or if my final-semester marksheet/registration renewal is pending?
faqs.answer: General practice in most Haryana recruitments is that you need the qualification/registration valid as on the closing date (21 August 2026) — provisional certificates are often accepted if the degree-awarding process is complete and only the final certificate is pending, but a renewal that is still "in process" with no valid certificate in hand is often risky. Please check the notification's exact wording before applying.

faqs.question: 6. Where do we send the hard copy of documents?
faqs.answer: Based on the how-to-apply steps in the official notification, this recruitment does not ask for a hard copy to be posted anywhere. The process is: fill the form online → pay fee → download the submitted application → sign every page → upload the scanned signed copy back onto the portal.

faqs.question: 7. Is this a permanent job or contractual?
faqs.answer: It's a regular, direct-recruitment permanent post under Haryana's AYUSH higher education system — not contractual. All selected candidates are posted at the SKAU campus in Kurukshetra (fixed location, not transferable).

faqs.question: 8. Can ANM nurses or other nursing streams apply for the Staff Nurse post?
faqs.answer: The eligibility for Staff Nurse specifically requires GNM or B.Sc. Nursing plus A-grade Nurse registration with the Haryana Nurses Registration Council. ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery) is typically registered as a separate, lower category (not "A-grade Nurse") in most state nursing councils, so an ANM-only qualification generally would not meet this post's requirement.

faqs.question: 9. For Clerk — is it just a typing test, or is there also a written exam/degree requirement?
faqs.answer:
It's a three-stage process, not typing-only:

1) Typing test (10 min, 15 marks, 30 NWPM minimum, computer-based)
2) Written MCQ test (90 min, 70 marks) — only for those who clear the typing test
3) Academic Achievement marks (15 marks, based on 10th/12th/Graduation percentage), verified at document verification

You also need a Graduation degree to be eligible at all — it's not open to non-graduates.

faqs.question: 10. When will the exam be conducted / what's the expected exam date?
faqs.answer: The official notification (dated 28 July 2026) covers the application window (30 July – 21 August 2026). The confirmed exam date will be announced separately via admit cards after the application window closes. Keep checking skau.ac.in for official updates.

faqs.question: 11. Why is the application portal/link not opening?
faqs.answer: General troubleshooting to suggest: try a different browser, clear cache, avoid peak-hour traffic close to the deadline, and use the official portal URL directly (recruitment.skau.ac.in/nonteaching) rather than third-party links.

faqs.question: 12. Where will exam centers be located? Will there be a center in Lucknow/UP?
faqs.answer: Exam center details are typically released with the admit card, closer to the exam date on the official portal.

faqs.question: 13. What is the sequence of the selection process? Is it a single-day exam?
faqs.answer: For Clerk: typing test happens first (only qualifiers proceed to the written test), so it is sequential. For Staff Nurse/Ayurvedic Pharmacist: it's a single written test, followed later by a separate document verification round (in a 1:5 shortlisting ratio) where academic achievement marks are added.

faqs.question: 14. When will the syllabus video be uploaded?
faqs.answer: Content schedules depend on individual creators. The official written test syllabus is already published in the notification.

faqs.question: 15. Can science graduates apply for the Clerk post?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Clerk eligibility just requires a Graduate degree from a recognised university (plus the typing/computer criteria) — the notification doesn't restrict it to a specific stream like commerce or arts, so science graduates are eligible.

faqs.question: 16. How many total vacancies are there for Clerk?
faqs.answer: 29 vacancies for Clerk (out of 60 total posts: Staff Nurse-25, Ayurvedic Pharmacist-6, Clerk-29).

faqs.question: Is this recruitment only for candidates from Rajasthan?
faqs.answer: Eligibility depends on the specific NLCIL project notification. For the NLC India Limited (NLCIL) Barsingsar Project Apprentice Recruitment, eligibility is strictly restricted to candidates belonging to the State of Rajasthan; candidates from other states are not eligible even with required qualifications. However, for NLCIL Neyveli Projects (Advt L&DC/02/2026 & L&DC/03/2026), eligibility is specified for Project Affected Persons (PAPs) of Neyveli projects and Wards/Spouses of NLCIL In-service/Retired/Deceased Employees and Contract Workmen.

faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply?
faqs.answer: No. For state/project-specific notifications such as the NLCIL Barsingsar Project (Rajasthan), candidates from states like Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh, or any other state cannot apply unless they fulfill the local state domicile/land acquisition requirement specified in the notification. For Neyveli notifications, only eligible PAPs or NLCIL employee/contract wards can apply.

faqs.question: Are Computer Science (CS/CSE) or Information Technology (IT) graduates eligible?
faqs.answer: Under NLCIL Neyveli Advt L&DC/02/2026 & L&DC/03/2026, Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) and Information Technology (IT) graduates ARE eligible for Engineering Graduate (38 PAP + 16 Employee/Contract slots) and Technician Diploma (5 PAP + 2 Employee/Contract slots) Apprentice posts. However, in certain regional notifications (such as the Barsingsar Project notice), CS/CSE/IT branches are not included in advertised disciplines, so CS/IT candidates cannot apply for those specific notices.

faqs.question: Can BCA students apply?
faqs.answer: Under NLCIL Neyveli Advt L&DC/02/2026 (30 slots for PAPs) and L&DC/03/2026 (12 slots for Employee/Contract wards), BCA graduates ARE eligible under Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice vacancies. However, if BCA is not listed among notified degree disciplines in a specific project notification (such as Barsingsar), BCA graduates cannot apply for that notification.

faqs.question: Can MCA students apply?
faqs.answer: No. MCA (Master of Computer Applications) is a Post-Graduate degree and is not an eligible qualification under NLCIL apprentice recruitment notifications. Candidates must possess only the specific Bachelor degree, Diploma, or ITI qualifications listed in the notification.

faqs.question: Is ITI Electrician eligible?
faqs.answer: Yes. ITI Electrician candidates are fully eligible (e.g. 55 PAP slots + 26 Employee/Contract slots under Neyveli notifications), provided they meet all conditions: belonging to the required candidate category (PAP / Employee Ward / Rajasthan Domicile), possessing a valid ITI Electrician certificate under Craftsman Training Scheme, fulfilling qualifying year rules, registering on the NAPS portal, and having no prior apprenticeship or 1+ year work experience.

faqs.question: Which ITI trades are eligible for NLCIL Apprenticeship?
faqs.answer: Eligible ITI trades under NLCIL notifications include: Electrician, Fitter, Turner, Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Wireman, Mechanic (Diesel), Stenographer, Welder, COPA (Computer Operator and Programming Assistant), Refrigeration & Air Conditioning (RAC) Technician, Plumber, and Horticulture (trade availability varies by project notification).

faqs.question: After filling the online application, where should I send the hard copy?
faqs.answer: For notifications requiring physical hard-copy submission (such as the NLCIL Barsingsar Project), after completing online registration, candidates must download & print the submitted application form, sign it, attach self-attested document copies, and send it to the Barsingsar Project Office of NLC India Limited by post or drop it in the designated collection box before the deadline. For Neyveli online registration, scanned documents are uploaded online directly at nlcindia.in.

faqs.question: Which documents should be attached with the hard copy or uploaded online?
faqs.answer: Candidates should attach / upload self-attested copies of: (1) Printed Application Form & NATS/NAPS Registration Number, (2) Aadhaar Card, (3) 10th SSLC Marksheet (DOB proof), (4) 12th HSC Marksheet, (5) ITI / Diploma / Degree Semester-wise & Consolidated Marksheets, (6) Provisional or Degree/Diploma Certificate, (7) Community Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS), (8) Transfer Certificate (TC), (9) CGPA to Percentage Conversion Certificate, and (10) Valid PAP Certificate / Employee ID / Contract Workman Form.

faqs.question: Can I submit only the online application without sending a hard copy?
faqs.answer: For Neyveli Advt L&DC/02/2026 & L&DC/03/2026, online application with scanned document uploads on nlcindia.in is complete. However, for project notifications specifying hard-copy submission (such as Barsingsar), completing only online registration is NOT sufficient; failing to submit the signed hard copy with documents before the deadline will lead to rejection.

faqs.question: Is there any written exam or interview for NLCIL Apprentice Selection?
faqs.answer: No. Selection for NLCIL Apprenticeship is 100% merit-based. There is NO written examination and NO interview. The merit list is prepared strictly based on aggregate marks obtained in the qualifying ITI, Diploma, or Degree examination.

faqs.answer: The 1-year sanitation work experience certificate must be issued by a competent authority as specified in the official recruitment notification. The experience should clearly show that you have worked in cleaning/sanitation-related duties for at least one year. Before applying, ensure your certificate matches the prescribed format and issuing authority mentioned in the notification. Submitting an invalid certificate may lead to rejection of your application.

faqs.question: Is a contractor (Thekedar) experience certificate valid?
faqs.answer: It depends on whether the contractor and the experience certificate satisfy the conditions laid down in the official notification. A certificate issued by a private contractor is not automatically valid. Candidates should carefully verify that the issuing authority and the certificate format are accepted by the recruitment rules before applying.

faqs.question: Is sanitation work experience from a government hospital valid?
faqs.answer: If you worked in sanitation or cleaning duties in a government hospital and your experience certificate has been issued by the competent authority in accordance with the recruitment rules, it may be considered valid. The final decision will be taken by the recruiting authority during document verification.

faqs.question: Is experience from a hotel, private office, or private company accepted?
faqs.answer: Experience from a hotel, private office, or private company may be accepted only if it fulfills all the eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification and is supported by a valid experience certificate issued by the competent authority. Candidates should not assume that every private-sector certificate will be accepted.

faqs.question: Can an NCC or NSS certificate be used instead of the experience certificate?
faqs.answer: No. NCC, NSS, Scout, or similar certificates cannot replace the mandatory 1-year sanitation work experience certificate. These certificates may reflect extracurricular participation but do not count as professional sanitation work experience unless specifically stated in the official notification.

faqs.question: Will selection be through a lottery or a written exam?
faqs.answer: As per the official notification, there is no written examination for this recruitment. The selection process will be carried out according to the procedure prescribed by the Rajasthan Government. Candidates should rely only on the official notification and avoid rumours circulating on social media regarding the selection process.

faqs.question: Is the selection based on money or corruption?
faqs.answer: No candidate should believe or pay money to anyone claiming to guarantee selection. The recruitment process is conducted by the competent government authority. If anyone demands money in exchange for selection, candidates should immediately report the matter to the concerned authorities. Trust only official notifications and announcements.

faqs.question: Should there be a written examination?
faqs.answer: Many candidates believe that a written examination would make the recruitment process more transparent. However, the recruitment process is decided by the Rajasthan Government. Candidates must follow the selection method prescribed in the official notification.

faqs.question: Is the salary only ₹7,000?
faqs.answer: No. The amount of ₹7,000 generally refers to the fixed remuneration during the probation/training period, if applicable. After successful completion of the probation period, employees receive salary according to the applicable Pay Matrix and government rules, along with admissible allowances. Candidates should refer to the official notification for exact salary details.

faqs.question: Will Safai Karamcharis have to clean drains and perform sanitation work?
faqs.answer: Yes. The duties of a Safai Karamchari generally include sanitation work such as cleaning roads, public places, drains, waste collection, and maintaining cleanliness as assigned by the local body. The exact responsibilities depend on the department and place of posting.

faqs.question: Can PWD (Persons with Disabilities) candidates apply?
faqs.answer: PWD candidates can apply if vacancies are reserved for their disability category and they satisfy all the eligibility conditions mentioned in the notification. Candidates should carefully check the reservation details and the list of eligible benchmark disabilities before submitting their application.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply?
faqs.answer: Candidates who satisfy the prescribed age limit, required sanitation work experience, and other eligibility conditions mentioned in the official notification can apply. All applicants must also fulfill the document and category requirements specified by the recruiting authority.

faqs.question: Can candidates from other states apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. Candidates from other states can generally apply if they fulfill the eligibility conditions. However, they may not receive the benefit of reservation available to Rajasthan domicile candidates unless specifically provided in the notification.

faqs.question: When will the Rajasthan Forest Guard Recruitment be released?
faqs.answer: The Rajasthan Government has not yet officially announced the next Forest Guard recruitment. Candidates should regularly check the Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB/RSMSSB) website and trusted job portals for the latest updates.

faqs.question: When will the Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI Recruitment be released?
faqs.answer: As of now, no official notification has been released for the Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI recruitment. Once the notification is published, details regarding vacancies, eligibility, syllabus, and the application process will be available on the official website.

faqs.question: What is the syllabus for Rajasthan Jal Vibhag ITI Recruitment?
faqs.answer: The syllabus will be released only after the official notification is published. Generally, ITI recruitments include questions related to the candidate's trade, General Knowledge, Reasoning, Mathematics, and basic language skills, depending on the specific post. overview: Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR), Maligaon, Guwahati has issued Employment Notification No. 04/2026 inviting online applications from eligible sports persons who are citizens of India for recruitment against Sports Quota through Open Advertisement for the year 2026-27.

A total of 56 vacancies are advertised across various sports disciplines including Archery, Athletics, Basketball, Badminton, Boxing, Cricket, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Weightlifting, Football, Golf, Kabaddi, and Power Lifting in Pay Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 (7th CPC).

Eligible sports persons aged 18 to 25 years as on 1st January 2027 with valid sports achievements on or after 1st April 2024 can apply online through the NFR official portal at www.nfr.indianrailways.gov.in. The online application portal opens on 25th July 2026 and closes on 24th August 2026.

reservation.title: Sports Quota Recruitment Terms & Guidelines
detailsList: There is no reservation for any community (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) in sports quota recruitment, but SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates must upload caste/income certificates for fee concession/exemption.
Selected candidates will be posted in NFR Divisions (Alipurduar, Katihar, Rangiya, Lumding, Tinsukia) or Zonal Headquarter Maligaon as per sports requirement.
Selected candidates must sign a Service Bond requiring them to serve for at least 5 years in Indian Railways.
Appointees will undergo a probation period of two years.

howToApply: Step 1: Visit the official website www.nfr.indianrailways.gov.in -> Go to "Recruitment against Sports Quota" section.
Step 2: Read Employment Notification No. 04/2026 carefully before filling up the online application form.
Step 3: Register online with an active mobile number and valid email ID.
Step 4: Enter personal details, educational qualifications, bank account details (for fee refund), and sports achievement details held on or after 01.04.2024.

Step 5: Upload scanned passport photograph (3.5cm x 4.5cm, 30-70 KB JPG), scanned signature (3.5cm x 2.5cm, 20-50 KB JPG), educational marksheets, DOB proof, caste/fee exemption certificates, and sports certificates.
Step 6: Pay the application fee (Rs. 500 or Rs. 250) online via payment gateway and submit the application form.
Step 7: Download and print the final submitted online application for future reference. Do NOT send physical printouts by post.

PARTIAL FEE REFUND: Candidates who appear for selection trials will be entitled to a partial refund of application fee. Bank details must be accurately entered in the online application form.
SERVICE BOND: Selected candidates will have to sign a Service Bond requiring them to serve for at least 5 years in Indian Railways.
PROBATION PERIOD: All candidates appointed through Sports Quota will undergo a probation period of two years.
WARNING AGAINST TOUTS: NF Railway has not appointed any agents or coaching centres. Recruitment is strictly on the basis of merit through trials and recognized achievements.

faqs.question: What is the opening and closing date for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026?
faqs.answer: Online applications open on 25.07.2026 and close on 24.08.2026.

faqs.question: What is the total number of vacancies in NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faqs.answer: There are a total of 56 vacancies across various sports disciplines in Level-1 (35 posts), Level-2, and Level-3 (21 posts).

faqs.question: What is the age limit for NFR Sports Quota recruitment?
faqs.answer: Candidates must be between 18 to 25 years as on 01.01.2027 (born between 02.01.2002 and 01.01.2009). No age relaxation is permissible under sports quota.

faqs.question: What are the educational qualifications required?
faqs.answer: Level 1 requires Class 10th pass / ITI / NAC. Level 2 and Level 3 require Class 12th (+2 stage) pass or equivalent.

faqs.question: What is the cut-off date for sports achievements?
faqs.answer: Sports achievements held on or after 01.04.2024 (in the immediate previous two financial years) will only be considered.

faqs.question: What is the selection process?
faqs.answer: Selection consists of a Sports Performance Trial (40 Marks, min 25 marks to qualify) followed by an Interview and evaluation of Sports Achievements (50 Marks) and Educational Qualifications (10 Marks).

faqs.question: Is the application fee refundable?
faqs.answer: Yes, candidates who actually appear for selection trials are entitled to a partial refund of the application fee.

faqs.question: Is there a service bond after selection?
faqs.answer: Yes, selected candidates must sign a Service Bond to serve Indian Railways for at least 5 years.
