howToApplySteps: Download and print the official application form (Proforma given in notification) on plain paper.
Fill out all required details in BLOCK letters (Name, Father's Name, DOB, Category, Address, Educational & Experience details).
Paste one recent passport size photograph (duly self-attested) on the application form and attach two additional self-attested photographs (with Name & Father's Name written on back).
Attach self-attested photocopies of 10th Marksheet/Certificate (Date of Birth proof), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Domicile, Caste/EWS Certificate, Driving License/Experience Certificate (if applicable).
Enclose one self-addressed registered envelope duly affixed with appropriate postal stamps.

Write on top of the outer cover envelope in CAPITAL letters: 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF _______' and indicate overall percentage in Matriculation using ink color rule (<=50%: RED ink, 51-60%: BLUE ink, >=61%: BLACK ink).

Send the completed application packet by Ordinary / Registered / Speed Post to: The Commandant, ASC Centre (South), Post - Agram, Bangalore - 560007 so as to reach within 21 days of publication (by 05 September 2026).
documentsRequired: Duly filled and signed Proforma Application Form
Matriculation / 10th Pass Certificate & Marksheet (Proof of DOB & Qualification)
Diploma / Certificate in Catering / Driving License / Experience Certificate (as applicable for trade)
Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
Domicile / PR Certificate
Caste / Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PWD/ESM)
Two self-attested passport size photographs (with name & father's name on back)
One self-addressed registered envelope with requisite postal stamps
importantInstructions: Candidates must apply for ONLY ONE trade. Applications for multiple trades will be rejected.
Envelopes must strictly follow ink color coding for Matriculation percentage (<=50%: Red, 51-60%: Blue, >=61%: Black).
Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India including High Altitude / Field areas.
All physical/skill/trade tests and written exam will be conducted at ASC Centre (South) Bangalore.

overview: The Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC), Bhubaneswar has published notification IIE-54/2026-1962/OSSSC for the recruitment of 5,989 District Cadre Group-C Nursing Officers across all 30 districts of Odisha under the Health & Family Welfare Department.

Candidates selected for this recruitment will be posted as Nursing Officers in district health infrastructure and may also be deployed as Community Health Officers (CHO) by the respective appointing authorities.

The online registration window opened on 13 June 2026 and the last date to register online has been extended to 16 August 2026 (with final application submission up to 19 August 2026). The examination fee of ₹500 is fully refunded to candidates who actually appear for the written examination.

education: 1. Academic Qualification: Must have passed 10+2 in the 10+2 system or its equivalent.

2. Professional Qualification: Must hold a Diploma in GNM (General Nursing & Midwifery) or BSc Nursing from any Medical College and Hospitals of the State or any other institution approved by the Indian Nursing Council.

3. Registration: Must have registered their name in the Nursing Council of the State of Odisha and possess a valid Registration or Renewal Certificate as on the date of submission of the online application form.

4. Odia Language Proficiency: Candidates must be able to speak, read, and write Odia and have satisfied one of the following: passed Middle School Exam with Odia as language subject; passed Matriculation or equivalent with Odia medium; passed Odia as language subject in Class-VII or above; or passed Odia test in M.E. School Standard conducted by School & Mass Education Department.
eligibility.ageLimit: As on 12 June 2026 (Date of Advertisement): 21 to 42 Years. Age Relaxation: SC / ST / SEBC / Women candidates get 5 years relaxation (upper limit 47 years); PwD candidates get 10 years relaxation (upper limit 52 years); PwD candidates under SC/ST/SEBC get cumulative 10 years over category relaxation; Ex-Servicemen get relaxation equal to period of defence service rendered; Contractual Nursing Officers under OSH&FW / ASHAs get upper limit up to 45 years.
medicalStandards: Must be an Indian citizen of good character.
If married, candidate must not have more than one spouse living.
PwD candidates must possess a Permanent Disability Certificate showing not less than 40% disability issued by Competent Authority.

salary.payLevel: Odisha Revised Scale of Pay (ORSP) Rules 2017 - Permanent Group-C District Cadre Post
salary.initialPay: Pay Matrix Level-8, Cell-01 with Pay Scale ₹29,200 - ₹92,300. Starting Basic Pay is ₹29,200/- per month.
allowances: Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Medical Allowance, and other perquisites as admissible under Government of Odisha rules.

selectionProcess.description: Single Written Exam consisting of 100 MCQs for 100 marks (2 hours duration in OMR or CBRE mode). Breakdown: 60 Qs from Nursing Syllabus (Annexure-II), 25 Qs on Practical Skills, 10 Qs on Arithmetic (HSC standard), 5 Qs on English (HSC standard). Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer. Minimum qualifying marks: 30% for ST/SC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Sportsperson, 35% for others.
Prepared after Written Test based on normalized marks. Shortlisted candidates for DV will be at not less than 1.25 times the number of advertised vacancies category-wise.
Shortlisted candidates appear before District Level Board in Office of Collector & District Magistrate. Original certificates verified by Chief District Medical & Public Health Officers.
Equal to advertised vacancies, drawn strictly based on merit, category, and candidate's district preference.

howToApplySteps: Step 1: Visit the OSSSC official website at www.osssc.gov.in.
Step 2: On the Home page, click 'Apply Online' if you are a New User. If registered previously, click 'Re-registration' under Applicant Menu.
Step 3: Keep scanned signature (20 KB - 50 KB) and colour passport photograph (20 KB - 100 KB) in JPG/JPEG/PNG format ready.
Step 4: Fill the Registration Form first and generate User ID & Password.
Step 5: Log in and complete the Online Application Form with academic, professional, and nursing council registration details.
Step 6: Select district preferences in order of priority (up to all 30 districts).
Step 7: Pay examination fee of ₹500 (if applicable) using Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card, or UPI and print Confirmation Page.
Step 8: Submit the online application before extended deadline of 19 August 2026.
documentsRequired: Certificate of Registration in Nursing Council of Odisha (valid as on online application submission date).
HSC (10th) examination certificate or equivalent proof of Date of Birth.
10+2 Pass Certificate & Marksheets.
Diploma in GNM or BSc Nursing Certificate & Marksheets.
Certificate of passing Odia language subject (Class VII / ME standard or HSC).
Caste Certificate (SC/ST/SEBC) or UDID Card/Disability Certificate showing min 40% permanent disability.
Discharge Certificate & Identity Card for Ex-Servicemen.
Contractual work experience certificate under OSH&FW / ASHA for age relaxation.
Sports ID Card issued by Sports & Youth Services Dept, Govt of Odisha (for Sportspersons).

faqs.question: What is the extended last date to apply for OSSSC Nursing Officer 2026?
faqs.answer: The extended last date for online registration is 16 August 2026, and the last date for submitting the full online application form is 19 August 2026.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are notified for OSSSC Nursing Officer 2026?
faqs.answer: A total of 5,989 Group-C District Cadre Nursing Officer posts are advertised across all 30 districts of Odisha.

faqs.question: What is the educational qualification for OSSSC Nursing Officer?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed 10+2, hold a Diploma in GNM or BSc Nursing from an Indian Nursing Council approved institution, and be registered with the Odisha Nursing Council.

faqs.question: Is the OSSSC Nursing Officer application fee refundable?
faqs.answer: Yes! The ₹500 fee paid by General/SEBC candidates will be refunded to candidates who actually appear in the written examination.

faqs.question: What is the pay scale for OSSSC Nursing Officer post?
faqs.answer: The pay scale is ₹29,200–₹92,300 at Pay Matrix Level-8, Cell-01 with starting basic pay of ₹29,200 per month.

faqs.question: What is the exam pattern for the OSSSC Nursing Officer Written Test?
faqs.answer: The Written Test is 100 marks MCQ (2 hours duration): 60 Qs from Nursing Syllabus, 25 Qs on Practical Skills, 10 Qs on Arithmetic (10th standard), and 5 Qs on English (10th standard). Negative marking is 0.25 per wrong answer.
